verdict.rationale: Stripe documents stablecoin financial accounts, cards, and support for the x402 machine-payment protocol, hinting at agent/programmatic payment flows, but there is no documentation of agent-specific wallet issuance, scoped API keys, policy controls, or explicit spend limits for autonomous agents. missing for 10: agent-scoped key issuance, policy/permission controls, documented spend limits for agents, independent corroboration of agentic wallet safety.
